evidence_standard.build_identity: The candidate is bound by repository, commit and candidate-bundle SHA-256 in a hash-checked evidence record under reports/releases/. At verification time the gate re-reads the build run from the component repository's public Actions records: it must be a completed, successful run of .github/workflows/benchmark-candidate.yml on the main branch for the exact commit, with exactly one unexpired artifact named benchmark-candidate-<commit>. Publication consumes only the distributions that the publish workflow's own input job extracts and re-verifies from that artifact.
evidence_standard.detector_battery: The frozen Spec 006 detector battery (five bundles under reports/aee-validation/) reproduced exactly under the candidate. For each bundle, the composed outcome, the lane-1 threshold block, the full score record (direct score, propagated score, band, components, notes) and the evidence-verification counts recorded in the evidence must equal the frozen records, whose SHA-256 hashes are checked against protected main at verification time, and the recorded re-score must report an exact match on every compared field.
evidence_standard.governance_anchor: The evidence cites this policy and the dated owner decision record by path and SHA-256; both hashes are checked against protected main at verification time, so an approval under this standard cannot outlive or detach from the decision that granted it.
evidence_standard.suites: The component repository's CI workflow is completed and successful at the exact candidate commit, re-read from public Actions records at verification time. The benchmark harness suite is green (zero failures, totals recorded in the evidence) at a lineage commit that is an ancestor of protected benchmark main, which the gate checks at verification time.

limitations: A governance evidence decision, not a matched-benchmark equivalence result. It establishes build identity, frozen-battery reproduction and suite health for one exact build. It does not establish that the candidate is non-inferior or superior to any baseline on policy-v1's metrics, and no such claim may be made from it. Approvals under this standard say which standard granted them; they are never valid as policy-v1 approvals.
status: Adopted by owner governance decision, 2026-10-24. Prospective: this standard governs release approvals registered under it from that date. policy-v1.json is unchanged and remains the registered standard for matched-benchmark approvals; no policy-v1 approval, verdict or frozen record is rewritten by this standard.

superseded_preconditions.exact_head_green_ci: Not applied under this standard. At the settlement head, the only failing benchmark CI step is dependency resolution against the unpublished candidate pin itself (uv reports that only applied-epistemic-engineering<=1.5.3 is available while the project requires >=1.6.0,<2), so requiring green benchmark CI before publication would make publication logically impossible. The gate records benchmark CI status at the resolved revision in its decision output instead, and post-publication CI verification is a required, publicly reported step of the settlement.
superseded_preconditions.matched_baseline: Not required under this standard. The 2026-10-24 modeling proved no campaign in the current design space can produce the matched rows policy-v1 requires, so the requirement is unproducible rather than merely unmet; see the decision record.
